name: shopify_app_store-mcp
description: Shopify App Store (marketplaces): me, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool maps to a do

platform_mcp_shopify_app_store_access_to.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_APP_STORE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_shopify_app_store_access_to.description: Partner API client access token (Partner Dashboard > Settings > Partner API clients, with the View financials permission for transactions and Manage apps for app data); 'The API client access token must belong to the organization that you're querying'. Sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest).

platform_mcp_shopify_app_store_organizat.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_APP_STORE_ORGANIZATION_ID
platform_mcp_shopify_app_store_organizat.description: Partner organization id from the Partners Dashboard URL (https://partners.shopify.com/{organization_id}/...); part of every endpoint URL.

tools.name: me
tools.description: The Partner API has no organization / viewer query; the probe runs publicApiVersions against the organization endpoint to prove that organization_id and the token work.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: app(id) with `product_id` = the app's Partner gid (e.g. gid://partners/App/1234): id, name, apiKey (raw). The Partner API carries no listing text, price or status for an app.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: transactions(types: APP_ONE_TIME_SALE, APP_SUBSCRIPTION_SALE, APP_USAGE_SALE; createdAtMin = `since` as an ISO-8601 DateTime; appId = `product_id` gid). `amount` is netAmount.amount (your earnings after Shopify's fee; a decimal string; grossAmount and shopifyFee are in raw), `status` is the transaction type; merchant emails are not exposed (the shop's myshopifyDomain and name are under raw.node.shop), so `customer_email` is null. Cursor-paginated: only the first `limit` transactions are returned (raw pageInfo.hasNextPage) and `page` is not honoured.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: App sale adjustments (refunds and other negative corrections of app charges) since `since` (ISO-8601 DateTime): amount is the (negative) netAmount; sale_id is the adjusted charge id. First `limit` rows only (cursor pagination).
